{{Quote|They're going to be fine. If anyone can do this, it's Han and Leia Solo.''"<br />"''I don't think you can promise that. Even Grandpa and Grandma don't usually fly ''into'' the middle of a Sith ambush&mdash;at least not on purpose.|Tenel Ka Djo and her daughter, [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana Solo]]|<ref name="Apocalypse" />}}
The '''evacuation''' of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] was the action taken by the [[New Jedi Order]] and the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]] in response to the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]'s seizure of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Under the leadership of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Kam Solusar]] and [[Tionne Solusar]] and the crew of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], the students, staff, and families present at the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]] on Ossus evacuated the planet while the forces of the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]] under the command of [[Queen Mother]] [[Tenel Ka Djo]] defended the evacuees from a group of Sith pilots.<ref name="Apocalypse" />

The entire academy was being evacuated, which included 322 students, 923 family members, and approximately 1,200 support staff.<ref name="Apocalypse" />
